embeddings.title: Gutegura inyandiko zawe
embeddings.description: Kwerekana dosiye zometseho kugirango zishakwe kandi zitangwe. Ibi birashobora gufata akanya kubwinyandiko nini.

creation.musicLyricsGuide: Sobanura injyana n’ijwi mu cyifuzo. Andika amagambo y’indirimbo munsi y’utumenyetso dukurikira. Zimya {{instrumental}} kugira ngo habeho kuririmba.
creation.setupStorage: Dosiye zose: {{download}}. Inyongera: {{reserve}}. Umwanya w’inyongera ukenewe: {{required}}. Ahari ubusa kuri disiki yatoranyijwe: {{free}}.
creation.setupSpaceMissing: Harabura {{missing}}. Shaka umwanya cyangwa uhitemo indi disiki ifite ububiko buhagije.
creation.setupTextNote: NVIDIA Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B Q4_K_M ni ikimodeli y'inyandiko ya mu kigo isanzwe ku rwego rwo kuganira, kwandika, kwita ku byo bikoresha, n'ibisubizo by'uburyo bw'inyandiko. Icyo gisanzwe ni 16K tokens; reba imemori isanzwe mbere yo kwinura. Inyandiko n'ubutumwa gusa, nta modeli y'inyandiko y'icyo gisanzwe. Gukoresha ikwibakira cyangwa ibyanditswe byawe kugira ngo ubone ibintu by'ukuri.
creation.setupImageNote: Ishusho — FLUX.2 Klein 4B · Q4_K_M. Inyandiko: Qwen3 4B · Q4_K_M · CPU. VAE: FLUX.2. Ikigereranyo: 21:9; Icyemezo: 1024 × 432; Intambwe y'ibisekuru: 4; Uburyo bwimbuto: Bisanzwe.
creation.setupMusicNote: Umuziki — ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo. Umutunganya umuziki: 2B · Q4_K_M; Umutegura umuziki: 1.7B · Q8_0; Inyandiko: Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B · Q8_0; VAE: BF16. Igihe cy’umuziki: 10–600 s; Ubwiza bw’amajwi: 48 kHz · 2.0; Umuziki utarimo indirimbo / Amagambo y’indirimbo; Bisanzwe.
creation.setupVideoNote: Video — Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B · Q4_K_M. Inyandiko: UMT5-XXL · Q4_K_M. Igihe cya videwo: 5 s; Ikigereranyo: 21:9; Frames kumasegonda: 16. Videwo ndende ziteranywa zivuye mu duce tugufi. Aho zahujwe hashobora kugaragara kandi kuyikora bishobora gutwara igihe kirekire. · MP4: Python + imageio-ffmpeg.
creation.setupAllNote: Ibyanditswe kandi byahindurwa ibimodeli by'ingenzi: Nemotron ku bw'inyandiko, Qwen3-Embedding Q8_0 ku kureba mu ndimi zitandukanye (CPU ni cyo gisanzwe), FLUX.2 Klein 4B (Ishusho) n'ibindi byo, Real-ESRGAN ×2/×4, ACE-Step ku muzika, na Wan2.1 ku gita. Reba uburebure bw'ibijyanye, aho ububiko bw'ikoranabuhanga n'ibyo bisanzwe ku gita haso. Ibyanditswe n'ibindi byo gukanda byashyizeho.
creation.videoDurationNote: Videwo ndende ziteranywa zivuye mu duce tugufi. Aho zahujwe hashobora kugaragara kandi kuyikora bishobora gutwara igihe kirekire.
creation.configure: Hitamo igicu cyerekana urufunguzo rwa API, cyangwa ugene moteri yatoranijwe yaho hamwe namadosiye asabwa mugushiraho.
creation.localNote: Amashusho yaho akoresha ububiko bwuzuye bwa Diffusers, gutandukanya GGUF / Safetensors hamwe na stabilite-diffusion.cpp, cyangwa ushyigikiwe na NVFP4 CUDA hamwe na Python 3.15.1. Video ikoresha Diffusers. Guhitamo CPU / GPU biratandukanye kuri encoder na generator yerekana amashusho muri moteri ishingiye kubigize.
creation.autosave: Amashusho na videwo byuzuye birabikwa mu buryo bwikora mububiko butandukanye bwa Novera imbere muri sisitemu yawe Amashusho nububiko bwa videwo, hamwe nibisekuru byabo.
creation.autoNote: Imodoka imenya ishusho isobanutse cyangwa amashusho yerekana amashusho mugifaransa nicyongereza. Urashobora buri gihe guhitamo imiterere yasohotse wenyine.
creation.variantPrompt: Kora verisiyo nshya yiyi shusho, ukomeze ingingo nyamukuru.
creation.missing: Ibi biremwa byimuwe cyangwa ntibikiboneka kuri iyi mudasobwa.
creation.desktopOnly: Gukora amashusho na videwo hamwe no kuzigama byikora birahari muri porogaramu ya desktop.
creation.inputUnsupported: Koresha ishusho imwe ishyigikiwe nicyitegererezo cyatoranijwe. Amashusho yerekana amashusho menshi yinjiza ntabwo ashyigikiwe hano.
creation.animatePrompt: Shushanya iyi shusho mugihe urinze ingingo nyamukuru yayo.
creation.filterNote: Ishusho na Video muyunguruzi ibyasohotse. Moderi nyinshi irashobora kumva ubwoko bwinshi bwinjiza; ibi ntabwo buri gihe bivuze ko bashobora kubyara amashusho cyangwa amashusho.
creation.generationOnly: Iyi moderi ikora itangazamakuru. Hitamo mu cyiciro cyangwa Ishusho.
creation.cloudNote: Igisekuru cyohereje ikibazo cyawe ninjiza ishusho kubatoranijwe kandi birashobora kwishyurwa. Guhagarara mugace ntibishobora guhagarika fagitire ya kure.
creation.cloudDefaults: Igicu gikoresha ibicuruzwa byihariye. Ibipimo byaho bikurikizwa kuri moteri yatoranijwe yo kurema.
creation.cloudTimeout: Akazi k'igicu ntikarangiye mugihe ntarengwa. Reba uko uhagaze hamwe nuwabitanze mbere yo gutangira ikindi gisekuru cyishyuwe.
creation.adobeCredentials: Adobe Firefly ikenera ikimenyetso cyo kwinjira hamwe na x-api-urufunguzo rwabakiriya mumiterere yabatanga.
creation.catalogNote: Uyu mutanga akoresha urutonde rwicyitegererezo. Kuvugurura ntabwo byemeza urufunguzo cyangwa konte yawe. Nta gisekuru cyishyuwe gikoreshwa mugupima ibyangombwa.
creation.ggufImageModel: Moderi ya Diffusion (GGUF cyangwa Safetensors ihuje)
creation.ggufTextEncoder: Kode ya kodegisi (GGUF cyangwa Umutekano uhuza)
creation.ggufNote: Hitamo ikwirakwizwa rya moderi, kodegisi yinyandiko na VAE ukwayo. Kuri FLUX.2 Klein 4B, koresha kodegisi ya Qwen3-4B ihuza, harimo na GGUF. Inkunga ya NVFP4 yateguwe rimwe hamwe na Python 3.15.1 na PyTorch muri cache nini ihuza; umwimerere ntigihinduka. Ibi bikeneye umwanya wongeyeho disiki na RAM. Kuri Windows, Novera ikubiyemo kandi icunga moteri mu buryo bwikora. Imodoka ikoresha ibyuma biboneka; CUDA ikeneye kubaka CUDA. Klein yatandukanijwe mubisanzwe ikoresha intambwe 4. na CFG 1. Nta buremere bwakuweho.
creation.ggufWrongModel: Iyi GGUF ikubiyemo kodegisi yinyandiko. Hitamo mumwanya wa encoder hanyuma uhitemo moderi itandukanye yo gukwirakwiza mumashusho.
creation.nativeNote: Kavukire NVFP4 CUDA: FLUX.2 Klein 4B Ibiro byiza, Qwen3-4B GGUF kodegisi na FLUX.2 Abashinzwe umutekano VAE. Irasaba Blackwell (RTX Urukurikirane 50 cyangwa ruhuye), Python 3.15.1, CUDA PyTorch nubushake NVFP4 kwishingikiriza. Umwandiko-ku-shusho gusa. Ibyuma bidashyigikiwe birananirana ku buryo bugaragara; hitamo stabilite-diffusion.cpp kugirango ihuze. Oya BF16 Ikwirakwizwa.
creation.deviceNote: Ibi bice bifite amahitamo yigenga. Imodoka ikoresha ibyuma biboneka; kavukire NVFP4 burigihe isaba GPU ihuje ibisekuruza kandi ikoresha inyandiko ya GPU mugihe iyo VRAM ihagije. Qwen kuri CPU irashobora kubika VRAM ariko kodegisi itinda. Qwen kuri GPU ikoresha ibice byubusa. Muri stabilite-diffusion.cpp, Imodoka ikurikira moteri yatoranijwe; guhatira CUDA bisaba kubaka CUDA.
creation.totalTimeHint: Igihe cyose kirimo gupakira, kodegisi yinyandiko, ibisekuruza, igicu icyo ari cyo cyose gitegereje, gukuramo no kuzigama. Igisekuru cyonyine cyerekanwa ukundi iyo moteri ibimenyesheje.
creation.recommendedSetupNote: Igisekuru cya GPU, Qwen3-4B kodegisi kuri CPU, intambwe 4, CFG 1. Yageragejwe kuri Windows hamwe na Vulkan; umuvuduko no guhuza biterwa nibyuma byawe.
creation.seedNote: Amashusho yaho gusa. Gereranya nicyitegererezo kimwe nigenamiterere.
creation.imageResolutionMax: Icyemezo ntarengwa muri Novera: 2048 × 2048 px. Ububiko buhagije burakenewe.
creation.upscaleNote: Nyuma yisekuru. Irasaba Python / PyTorch. Umusaruro ntarengwa: × 2 4096 × 4096, × 4 8192 × 8192.
creation.upscaleMissing: Shyiramo moderi cyangwa uhitemo dosiye ihuza .pth, hanyuma urebe Python / PyTorch.
creation.sizeAutoNote: Guhindura igipimo gihuza imyanzuro iriho. Ibipimo bikoresha inshuro 16, kugeza 2048 px.
creation.setupTextNvfp4Note: Inyungu z'NVFP4 z'ingenzi z'NVIDIA Blackwell GPU cyangwa nshya zikoresheje 4.5 GiB cyangwa kirekire cy'VRAM. Kugira ngo ubigire muri Novera, ikibazo cyose cy'model cyo gusubirwa mbere kuri NVFP4 GGUF cy'ikoreshwa kandi cyerekanye. Iki gukoresha ntiberekanye kuri iki checkpoint. Iki fayili cy'Safetensors cy'ikoreshejwe ntishobora gukoreshwa neza n'ikiganiro cy'ingingo. Q8_0 rishobora gukoreshwa neza nk'inshingano. Ibibazo by'ububiko bikaba byishingiye kandi ku gihe cy'ubutumwa.

memory.title: Ububiko bw'icyitegererezo bwibanze
memory.autoNote: Yikoreza moderi kubisabwa kandi irekura moderi idakoreshwa nyuma yimirimo irangiye.
memory.manualNote: Inyandiko, ishusho na videwo birashobora gukorera hamwe mubiganiro bitandukanye niba RAM / VRAM byemewe. Abanyamideli barashobora kubura kwibuka.
memory.preserve: Amadosiye n'ibiganiro birabikwa; moderi yisubireho mugihe bikenewe. Impinduka zikurikizwa kubisabwa bishya.
memory.failed: Kwibuka neza byarananiranye. Ongera usubiremo cyangwa uhitemo Igitabo.

instructions.textDefault: Uri Novera. Subiza neza, neza kandi neza mururimi rwumukoresha. Kurikiza imbogamizi zabo, genzura ibintu byingenzi mugihe bishoboka na leta idashidikanywaho. Ntuzigere uhimba inkomoko, ibisubizo cyangwa ibikorwa byuzuye.
instructions.imageDefault: Kurikiza ingingo wasabwe, imiterere no gushushanya. Koresha ibihimbano bisobanutse, kumurika hamwe nibisobanuro byiza. Kubika indangamuntu; irinde kugoreka nibintu udashaka. Ongeraho inyandiko gusa iyo ubisabwe.
instructions.videoDefault: Kurikiza ingingo wasabwe, imiterere nigihe bimara. Komeza ingingo, ibintu n'amatara bihuye kumurongo. Koresha kugenda neza no kugenzura kamera. Irinde guhindagurika, kugoreka hamwe ninyandiko itabajijwe.
